title: BlueIS
description: A prototype service ledger and resource planning system for academic personnel. It models faculty service as a temporal state machine, and tracks FTE, course loads, advancement history, leave status, etc. quarter-by-quarter.
lastChange: Split appointments and FY faculty stuff is now (painfully) done(?). Check out the live log.

title: Practica
description: A prototype shared event planning and task assginment tool - 'kanban-inspired' stuff to allow teams to get a better sense of who is doing what, and when, for events.

title: Summer Compensation Calculator
description: Derives a maximum available summer compensation from an annual salary. Users can then explore summer-research scenarios by activating months and adjusting FTE. Built for faculty on 9/12 appointments. Optimized for inclusion in external sites via iFrame.
lastChange: Removed the 95.46% thing for June – no longer necessary!

title: BudgetVis
description: Lets you upload two IPA Budget Exports in Excel format to create a quick 'before and after' picture of the year-over-year change.
lastChange: Basic look/feel updates, plus a new PDF export function.

title: Leave Date Conversion Tool
description: A web-based tool for calculating service and pay period dates, replacing the need to track down the manual Excel lookup files.
lastChange: Updated to use a central JSON file for base dates.

title: Sabbatical Planning Calculator
description: Enter a sabbatical credit total and annual salary, then activate quarters, play with salary level and residency, and see the impact on sabbatical credit usage and total salary. Optimized for inclusion in external sites via iFrame.
lastChange: Added graceful handling of commas in salaries.

title: Merit & Promotion Roadmap
description: Quickly visualize the multi-year timeline of an academic career. Models standard APM service intervals (2 vs 3 years), dossier preparation lead-times, and promotion eligibility checkpoints. Intended for Academic Personnel staff sitting down with faculty.
lastChange: Added lateral promotion option and applicability-checking logic.

title: Lecturer Pay Calculator
description: Focuses on the creation of an employment plan for Unit 18 / Continuing Lecturers. Create an employment schedule, with IWC, then receive salary and benefit information and a CSV export.
lastChange: Updated to use a central JSON file for base rates for easier updating.

title: Roster Parser
description: Upload a roster export from SIS (XLS, XLSX, CSV) to return a simple list of 'course code / course number / instructor name / CRN'. Handles untrusted and trusted exports.

title: Student Employment Cost Calculator
description: Create an 'employment schedule' for graduate student employees and display the costs associated. Features proper proration of same-quarter multiple-appointment benefits and work-study. 'GSR Version' and 'STDT Version' are optimized for inclusion in external sites via iFrame.
lastChange: Updated to use a central JSON file for base rates.

title: Summer Salary Scratchpad
description: Calculates detailed summer session compensation for TAs, AIs, and Lecturers based on annual salary rates and units, including benefit costs and maximum salary caps.

title: IPA-Disclosure Double Checker
description: Takes a Support Assignments XLSX exported from IPA and quickly pulls out name, email, and title to streamline the Disclosure Process check.

title: Employee Disclosure Workflow
description: This ZIP folder contains each piece of the Employee Disclosure workflow. Email to be added to the AI model, or request a Zoom for help.

title: Docusign 'eForms' Example
description: Contains Docusign templates to create Powerforms for Grad Studies Legacy Forms and example HTML for a SiteFarm page.
